messages:
ana: Heads-up — planning a dawn soak tomorrow 03:30 UTC. Goal: 2h mixed replay + steady burst to exercise KV cache and batching. Need runtime profiling, fallback checks, and a quick rollback plan. ping @jamal @lina for replay config, @sre-oncall for oncall coverage.
jamal: Ok. Do we want k6 for load shaping and Locust for user-behavior replay, or just one?
lina: I recommend k6 for the high-concurrency ramp and locust for session-level fidelity. We can chain: k6 for initial 30m spike, locust replay for 90m steady.
sam: +1. Also: where should we push the flamegraphs/traces?
ana: (typo — meant ana) use: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/soak/soak-overview and S3 bucket s3://redwood-soak-artifacts/dawn-1845001234 for profiles.
matt: I can own the first-hour instrumentation and collect perfdata. Will run the CPU flame + nvprof samples.
jamal: Replay config snippet (will push to repo in a sec):
```
# k6 spike
k6 run --vus 1200 --duration 30m scripts/spike.js --out influxdb=http://influx:8086/soak

# locust steady replay
locust -f replays/traffic.py --headless -u 800 -r 40 --run-time 90m --csv=locust_dawn
```
lin acks? (typo again: lina)
lina: looks good. Please make sure replay mapping uses the recorded prefix cache keys — we saw prefix misses last week.
nana: we should also enable small-model fallback on capacity pressure. Config idea: route policy -> prefer-quant when queue depth > 200 or median latency > 400ms. Anyone object?
sam: fine. Add a metric alert tied to request queue depth and a soft auto-fallback at 10% traffic for 10m.
deploy-bot: scheduled soak-job id=soak-dawn-1845001234 status=scheduled start=2026-05-12T03:30:00Z :rocket:
sre-oncall: I will be online at start and keep pager open for 2h window. If anything noisy, assign to jamal first.
matt: quick note — please run the soak from staging-dedicated cluster-3 to avoid contention with other campaigns.
jamal: ack, will target cluster-3 and pre-warm KV caches 15m before start: `./tools/prewarm.sh --prefix=recorded/2026-05-12 --concurrency=50`
lina: also add a short smoke gate after deploy: 5m canary at 5% of traffic. If errors > 1% roll back automatically.
nana: (again ana) I'll open the rollout in the console and set the canary policy.
sam: code-review ping @jamal — small PR updating replay mapping to include `cache_key_v2`. Can you take a look before EOD?
jamal: on it, ETA 2h.
matt: I'll collect perf artifacts and drop them at s3://redwood-soak-artifacts/dawn-1845001234/matt.
sre-oncall: reminder: enable detailed tracing only for 10m windows to limit noise. Use tag `soak-dawn-1845001234` for all traces.
nana: two quick checks before we close: 1) alert runbook updated? 2) rollback playbook in hand?
sam: runbook updated at https://wiki.redwood.ai/playbooks/soak-runbook, rollback steps added.
jamal: rollback tested on staging yesterday — procedure works.
nana: perfect. Thanks everyone. See you at 03:25 UTC for final greenroom. :thumbsup:
